candidate_action_item_owner_coherent_ck.name: candidate_action_item_owner_coherent_ck
candidate_action_item_owner_coherent_ck.value:
("candidate_action_item"."owner_confidence" = 'unresolved' AND "candidate_action_item"."owner_person_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("candidate_action_item"."owner_confidence" <> 'unresolved' AND "candidate_action_item"."owner_person_id" IS NOT NULL)

candidate_action_item_review_provenance_.name: candidate_action_item_review_provenance_ck
candidate_action_item_review_provenance_.value:
("candidate_action_item"."review_status" = 'pending' AND "candidate_action_item"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "candidate_action_item"."reviewed_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("candidate_action_item"."review_status" = 'auto_approved' AND "candidate_action_item"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("candidate_action_item"."review_status" IN ('approved','rejected') AND "candidate_action_item"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "candidate_action_item"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

person_identity_link_provenance_ck.name: person_identity_link_provenance_ck
person_identity_link_provenance_ck.value:
("person_identity"."person_id" IS NULL AND "person_identity"."confidence" IS NULL AND "person_identity"."linked_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("person_identity"."person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "person_identity"."confidence" IS NOT NULL AND "person_identity"."linked_at" IS NOT NULL)

tracked_item_content_by_source_ck.name: tracked_item_content_by_source_ck
tracked_item_content_by_source_ck.value: "tracked_item"."source_system" = 'internal' OR ("tracked_item"."title" IS NULL AND "tracked_item"."description" IS NULL)

tracked_item_external_ref_ck.name: tracked_item_external_ref_ck
tracked_item_external_ref_ck.value:
("tracked_item"."source_system" = 'internal' AND "tracked_item"."external_task_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("tracked_item"."source_system" <> 'internal' AND "tracked_item"."external_task_id" IS NOT NULL)
